v WHERE v.code = 'GLD.JE_TRX_DTL_STATUS' AND v.code_value = gjtd.STATUS ) AS STATUS, GJTD.COMPANY_ID FROM GLD_JE_TRX_DTL GJTD JOIN EFT_FUND_TRANSFER_LIST EFTL ON GJTD.JE_SOURCE_ID=EFTL.TRANSFER_LIST_ID LEFT JOIN LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW LCW ON LCW.WITHDRAW_ID=EFTL.SOURCE_DOC_ID AND EFTL.SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY='LON_CONTRACT_REPAYMENT' LEFT JOIN CT_ABS_PRODUCT CAP ON CAP.PRODUCT_ID=EFTL.SOURCE_DOC_ID AND EFTL.SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY!='LON_CONTRACT_REPAYMENT' AND EFTL.SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY!='CT_ABS_PROJECT_FEE' LEFT JOIN CT_ABS_PROJECT CAJ ON CAJ.PROJECT_ID=EFTL.SOURCE_DOC_ID AND EFTL.SOURCE_DOC_CATEGORY= 'CT_ABS_PROJECT_FEE' WHERE GJTD.JE_SOURCE_DOC='EFT_FUND_TRANSFER_LIST' UNION SELECT ( SELECT gjt.DESCRIPTION FROM GLD_JE_TRX GJT WHERE GJT.JE_TRX = GJTD.JE_TRX ) AS DESCRIPTION, (SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'GLD.OPERATE_TYPE' AND v.code_value = gjtd.OPERATE_TYPE) OPERATE_TYPE_N, CAP.PRODUCT_NUMBER CONTRACT_NUMBER, CAP.PRODUCT_NAME CONTRACT_NAME, GJTD.JE_TRX_ID, GJTD.JE_TRX, GJTD.JE_TRX_DTL_ID, GJTD.MSG_LOG, GJTD.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, GJTD.JE_SOURCE_ID, GJTD.JE_SOURCE_DOC, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM
v WHERE v.code = 'GLD.JE_TRX_DTL_STATUS' AND v.code_value = gjtd.STATUS ) AS STATUS, GJTD.COMPANY_ID FROM GLD_JE_TRX_DTL GJTD JOIN CT_ABS_PRODUCT CAP ON GJTD.JE_SOURCE_ID=CAP.PRODUCT_ID WHERE GJTD.JE_SOURCE_DOC='ABS_PRODUCT' UNION
SELECT ( SELECT gjt.DESCRIPTION FROM GLD_JE_TRX GJT WHERE GJT.JE_TRX = GJTD.JE_TRX ) AS DESCRIPTION, (SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'GLD.OPERATE_TYPE' AND v.code_value = gjtd.OPERATE_TYPE) OPERATE_TYPE_N, CAP.PRODUCT_NUMBER CONTRACT_NUMBER, CAP.PRODUCT_NAME CONTRACT_NAME, GJTD.JE_TRX_ID, GJTD.JE_TRX, GJTD.JE_TRX_DTL_ID, GJTD.MSG_LOG, GJTD.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, GJTD.JE_SOURCE_ID, GJTD.JE_SOURCE_DOC, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM
v WHERE v.code = 'GLD.JE_TRX_DTL_STATUS' AND v.code_value = gjtd.STATUS ) AS STATUS, GJTD.COMPANY_ID FROM GLD_JE_TRX_DTL GJTD JOIN CT_ABS_PRODUCT_RECEIPT CAPR ON GJTD.JE_SOURCE_ID=CAPR.RECEIPT_ID JOIN CT_ABS_PRODUCT CAP ON CAPR.PRODUCT_ID=CAP.PRODUCT_ID WHERE GJTD.JE_SOURCE_DOC='ABS_PRODUCT_RECEIPT'
UNION SELECT ( SELECT gjt.DESCRIPTION FROM GLD_JE_TRX gjt WHERE gjt.JE_TRX = gjtd.JE_TRX ) AS DESCRIPTION, (SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'GLD.OPERATE_TYPE' AND v.code_value = gjtd.OPERATE_TYPE) OPERATE_TYPE_N, ( select lcw.withdraw_number from lon_contract_withdraw lcw where lcw.withdraw_id = gjtd.JE_SOURCE_ID ) CONTRACT_NUMBER, ( select lcw.report_name from lon_contract_withdraw lcw where lcw.withdraw_id = gjtd.JE_SOURCE_ID ) CONTRACT_NAME, gjtd.JE_TRX_ID, gjtd.JE_TRX, gjtd.JE_TRX_DTL_ID, gjtd.MSG_LOG, gjtd.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, gjtd.JE_SOURCE_ID, gjtd.JE_SOURCE_DOC, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM
v WHERE v.code = 'GLD.JE_TRX_DTL_STATUS' AND v.code_value = gjtd.STATUS ) AS STATUS, gjtd.COMPANY_ID FROM GLD_JE_TRX_DTL gjtd WHERE (gjtd.JE_SOURCE_DOC not in ('CON_CONTRACT','LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW','FCT_CONTRACT','LON_CONTRACT_REPAYMENT','CT_DOCUMENT_FIN_INCOME','RESERVE_PLAN_LN','EFT_FUND_TRANSFER_LIST','ABS_PRODUCT','ABS_PRODUCT_RECEIPT') or gjtd.je_source_doc is null) ) tab
and tab.STATUS IN
#{item}
and tab.STATUS = #{statusN}
AND tab.JE_TRX = #{jeTrx}
AND tab.DESCRIPTION = #{jeTrxN}
AND (tab.CONTRACT_NAME LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{contractName}),'%') OR tab.CONTRACT_NAME LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{contractName}),'%'))
AND (tab.CONTRACT_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{contractNumber}),'%') OR tab.CONTRACT_NAME LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{contractNumber}),'%'))
AND tab.JE_TRX_DTL_ID = #{jeTrxDtlId}
AND trunc(tab.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) = trunc(#{lastUpdateDate})
and tab.LAST_UPDATE_DATE>= #{lastUpdateDateFromStr}
and tab.LAST_UPDATE_DATE <= #{lastUpdateDateToStr}
AND tab.description = #{description}
order by LAST_UPDATE_DATE desc
